description: Keles et al. 2024 (bmovie). scene_cut: rows of the pinned scenecut_info.csv, onset timestamps[shot_start_fr - 1] of the string series stimulus/presentation/movieframe_time (its data is the 0-based frame position), cut_kind change when scene_id differs from the previous row and row 0 forced to change (release code and paper: 13 changes, 80 continuity cuts). recognition_onset: trials rows with stim_phase recognition; familiarity buckets actual_response 1-3 novel and 4-6 familiar; window drawn [-1, 2] s and tested over the response window [0.2, 1.7] s (release code). movie_onset: the one encoding row, single. LFP time is trials time + 10 s (series description and release code), so lfp_clock_offset_s is 10.
